answer_text: A redox reaction is one in wich oxidation and reduction take place together. Zinc metal displaces copper: Zn + CuSO4 -> ZnSO4 + Cu. Zinc atoms lose electrons and become Zn2+, so zinc is oxidised. Copper(II) ions gain those electrons and become copper metal, so copper is reduced. Becuase electrons are transferred from zinc to copper, the displacement is a redox reaction.
